name: Town Square Shopping Centre gable
observations: Distinct brick gabled frontage with curved TOWN SQUARE SHOPPING CENTRE lettering around a circular/oval centre motif.
Arched dark/greenish lower display opening with a pale surround and separate signage.
Small decorative brick details, projecting gutter/eaves and roof/chimney silhouette are important landmarks.
Adjoins B&M gabled mass and the lower northbound retail terrace.
Delivery van strongly occludes several views; primary234 is better for the gable than246.
Do not equate this gable with the separate Town Square passage frontage B031.
unknowns: Exact dimensions, rear elevation and interior layout are not established. Street View address is a camera label, not this unit address.
review_basis: All listed captures reviewed in contact sheets; selected originals also inspected at native resolution. Notes describe visible appearance, not surveyed construction.
placement_confidence: Approximate frontage marker derived from camera route, side and estimated offset; not a measured footprint.

map_position.method: Estimated offset from photographed camera route; B050 uses Google place pin. Not measured building geometry.
